name: 揭角
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinctive production Windows app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit. Concept A: PEEL TO REFINE. An elegant square icon tile made of layered ultramarine blue and pale ice-blue sheets, with the upper colored corner curling back in one decisive sculptural fold to reveal a pristine bright layer underneath. The peeled corner is the defining silhouette, communicating changing an icon's overlay. Premium restrained Fluent-inspired dimensional design, unmistakable at 32 px, sophisticated geometry, crisp broad surfaces, not cartoonish. No enclosing generic rounded-square background; the layered peeled tile itself is the whole icon. True transparent outer canvas, centered, generous clear padding, no cast shadow outside the shape, no flecks. No text, no letters, no pencil, no gear, no Windows logo. Single finished icon only.

name: 像素重组
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinctive production Windows app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit. Concept B: PIXEL REFORM. A bold sculptural midnight-indigo square icon with a clearly recognizable lower-right corner being reconstructed from exactly THREE large staggered square pixels in bright cyan, lavender and electric violet. The separated pixels align into the icon and suggest editing its corner. Restrained polished 2.5D Fluent materials, broad simple planes, crisp straight geometry with subtle softened edges, strong memorable silhouette that works at 24 and 32 pixels. This is a unique icon symbol, not a generic blue rounded-square containing another icon. Actual transparent background, centered with clear padding, no text, no letters, no pencil, no gear, no extra particles or tiny decoration, no glow beyond object. Single finished icon only.

name: 角标剥离
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinctive production Windows app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit. Concept C: DETACH THE BADGE. A beautifully designed cobalt-to-turquoise desktop icon tile floating upright, with its small amber corner badge sliding away from the lower-right notch, a precise visible gap between the main icon and the detached badge. One main geometric form and one small square badge only, communicating removal and customization of desktop icon overlays. The interlocking notch and badge must form an original striking silhouette. Sophisticated restrained Fluent 2.5D shading, exceptionally clean edges and strong legibility at 32 px. Actual transparent surrounding canvas with generous padding. No text, no letters, no arrow glyph, no shield, no pencil, no gears, no generic app-store frame, no particles, no shadow outside objects. Single finished icon only.

name: 负形切角
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinctive production Windows app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit. Concept D: PRECISION CUT. An original minimal iconic mark: two offset interlocking angular corner brackets forming an open square frame, with a single precise diagonal cut at the bottom-right separating a small floating diamond corner. Restrained jade green with deep petrol-blue accent. Architectural modern symbol, geometric and confident, nearly flat with only very subtle dimensional edge, plenty of negative space, instantly recognizable at 16 or 32 px. This abstract mark conveys editing the boundary and corner of an icon. Do not place the mark inside another rounded-square tile; the mark is the entire icon. Truly transparent outside, centered with generous padding, no letters or text, no pencil, no gear, no Windows logo, no sparkles, no noisy edges. Single finished icon only.
